title: IEEE 754 Single Precision: The 1 + 8 + 23 Layout and Decoding
quickIdea: Thirty-two bits are 1 sign bit, 8 exponent bits biased by 127 and 23 fraction bits; for a normal number the value is (-1)^s x 1.F x 2^(E - 127).
remember: Layout: 1 sign, 8 exponent, 23 fraction. Double precision is 1, 11 and 52 with bias 1023.
The value formula holds for normal numbers, that is for 1 <= E <= 254.
To decode: read the sign, read E as unsigned, subtract 127 to get the true exponent, then move the binary point that many places right in 1.F.
To encode: normalise, add 127 to the exponent, and drop the leading 1 of the significand. The fraction bits are the digits after the point.
A hexadecimal word is not a number until it is bits. The sign is the top bit of the first hex digit, and the exponent field straddles the first two hex digits.
The 23 fraction bits give about 7 significant decimal digits, which is why single precision prints as roughly seven digits and double as roughly sixteen.

example.work: C2710000 is 1100 0010 0111 0001 followed by sixteen zeros. Sign 1, so negative. Exponent field 1000 0100 = 132, so the true exponent is 132 - 127 = 5. Fraction begins 1110001, so the significand is 1.1110001 = 1 + 0.5 + 0.25 + 0.125 + 0.0078125 = 1.8828125. Move the point five places: 111100.01, which is 60.25. With the sign, -60.25.

gateAngle: Three verified questions in this topic are pure decoding or encoding: 2012 Q.7 (0.5), 2021 Set 1 Q.24 (-7.75) and 2026 Set 2 Q.34 (0xC2710000 to -60.25). None needs arithmetic on the significand - only the bias and the hidden bit.

variations.label: VERIFIED PYQ
variations.question: GATE CSE 2021 Set 1 Q.24: S = 1, E = 10000001, F = 11110000000000000000000, bias 127. The decimal value rounded to two places is ______.
variations.why: E = 129, so the true exponent is 2. The significand is 1.1111 = 1.9375, and -1.9375 x 4 = -7.75.

variations.label: VERIFIED PYQ
variations.question: GATE CSE 2026 Set 2 Q.34: The 32-bit IEEE 754 single-precision representation of a number is 0xC2710000. The number in decimal, to two places, is ______.
variations.why: Sign 1, exponent field 132 giving 5, significand 1.8828125; -1.8828125 x 32 = -60.25.

variations.label: VERIFIED PYQ
variations.question: GATE CSE 2012 Q.7: The decimal value 0.5 in IEEE single precision representation has: (A) fraction bits 000...000 and exponent value 0, (B) fraction bits 000...000 and exponent value -1, (C) fraction bits 100...000 and exponent value 0, (D) no exact representation.
variations.why: 0.5 = 1.0 x 2^(-1), so the fraction field is all zeros and the true exponent is -1, stored as 126. The hidden 1 supplies the leading digit, so the fraction field is empty rather than 100...000.

trap.what: Dropping the hidden leading 1, or forgetting to subtract the bias.
trap.why: The stored fraction is only the part after the binary point of the significand; the 1 in front of it is implied by the normal form. And the exponent field is 127 larger than the exponent used in the value.
trap.counterexample: For 0xC2710000, dropping the hidden 1 gives 0.8828125 x 32 = 28.25, and forgetting the bias gives 1.8828125 x 2^132. Both are far from -60.25, and both are common exam answers.

check.question: Decode 0x3F800000 as a single-precision float.
check.explanation: Sign 0; exponent field 0111 1111 = 127, so the true exponent is 0; fraction all zeros, so the significand is 1.0. The value is 1.0 x 2^0 = 1.
